breaking.change: Removed. Every decal names its own texture; the renderer keeps the textures a frame's decals name in an atlas of its own, so decals from different effect packs and the game's own no longer share one texture the game had to build and set.
breaking.fix: Delete the line that sets decalAtlas and set that texture on each decal instead: og.Decal.texture, or a `texture "<id>"` line in a vfx file's `decal` element. uvMin, uvMax and `uv` stay as they are: they are now a region of the decal's own texture.

breaking.change: Removed. A decal's normal map is its own texture, og.Decal.normalMap, read over the same uvMin to uvMax region as its image.
breaking.fix: Put the normal map in a texture laid out as the colour texture is (each mark's map in the cell its colour has) and set og.Decal.normalMap to it.

breaking.change: A `decal` element's `uv` is a region of its own `texture` line, not of og.RenderSettings.decalAtlas. A decal with no `texture` draws a square of its colour.
breaking.fix: Add `texture "<the atlas's id>"` to each `decal` element that has a `uv` line.

breaking.change: Removed: an effect's decals carry their textures.
breaking.fix: Drop the flag and name the texture in the effect's `decal` element.

added.summary: A decal's image and its tangent-space normal map, each any loaded texture (a sheet of several marks is one texture, each decal a region of it).

A `decal` element takes `texture`, `normal`, `normalScale`, `emissive`, `roughness`, `metallic`, `wet`, `angleFade` and `turn` (a random turn per instance), so an effect leaves a scorch with glowing embers, a crater with a raised rim, a bullet hole or a wet splash mark with its own textures.
